SELECT
  COALESCE((SELECT SUM(invoice) FROM bc_job_ledger_entry_month
    WHERE company_name = $1 AND year = $2::int
      AND concepto_analitico_descripcion = 'Ingresos'), 0) AS r_sum,
  COALESCE((SELECT SUM(invoice) FROM bc_job_planning_line
    WHERE company_name = $1 AND year = $2::int
      AND status IN ('Planning','Quote','Open','Completed','Lost')
      AND job_no NOT LIKE 'PP%' AND job_no NOT LIKE 'PY%'
      AND (
        COALESCE(budget_date_year, 0) = 0
        OR (budget_date_year = year AND month >= budget_date_month)
      )), 0) AS p_planif_sum,
  COALESCE((SELECT SUM(cost) FROM bc_job_planning_line
    WHERE company_name = $1 AND year = $2::int
      AND status IN ('Planning','Quote','Open','Completed','Lost')
      AND job_no NOT LIKE 'PP%' AND job_no NOT LIKE 'PY%'
      AND (
        COALESCE(budget_date_year, 0) = 0
        OR (budget_date_year = year AND month >= budget_date_month)
      )), 0) AS p_cost_sum,
  COALESCE((SELECT SUM(cost) FROM bc_job_ledger_entry_month
    WHERE company_name = $1 AND year = $2::int), 0) AS r_cost_sum,
  COALESCE((SELECT SUM(invoice) FROM bc_expediente_mes
    WHERE company_name = $1 AND year = $2::int
      AND job_no NOT LIKE 'PP%' AND job_no NOT LIKE 'PY%'
      AND COALESCE(month_closing_status, '') NOT IN ('Completed', 'Lost')
  ), 0) AS p_expediente_sum,
  COALESCE((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bc_meses_cerrados
    WHERE company_name = $1
      AND job_no NOT LIKE 'PP%' AND job_no NOT LIKE 'PY%'), 0) AS cerrados_count,
  COALESCE((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bc_job_planning_line
    WHERE company_name = $1 AND year = $2::int
      AND budget_date_year = 0 AND COALESCE(invoice,0) <> 0
      AND status IN ('Open','Planning')
      AND make_date(year, month, 1) < date_trunc('month', CURRENT_DATE)), 0) AS budget0_past_count,
  COALESCE((SELECT SUM(facturado) FROM v_se_facturacion
    WHERE empresa = $1 AND year = $2::int AND tipo IN ('P','R')), 0) AS planificacion_actual,
  COALESCE((SELECT SUM(facturado) FROM v_se_facturacion
    WHERE empresa = $1 AND year = $2::int AND tipo = 'R'), 0) AS v_se_facturacion_r,
  COALESCE((SELECT SUM(facturado) FROM v_se_facturacion
    WHERE empresa = $1 AND year = $2::int AND tipo = 'P'), 0) AS v_se_facturacion_p,
  COALESCE((SELECT jsonb_object_agg(job, s) FROM (
    SELECT job, ROUND(SUM(facturado)::numeric, 2) AS s
    FROM v_se_facturacion
    WHERE empresa = $1 AND year = $2::int AND tipo = 'R'
      AND job NOT LIKE 'PP%' AND job NOT LIKE 'PY%'
    GROUP BY job
  ) t), '{}'::jsonb) AS v_se_facturacion_r_by_job,
  COALESCE((SELECT jsonb_object_agg(job, s) FROM (
    SELECT job, ROUND(SUM(facturado)::numeric, 2) AS s
    FROM v_se_facturacion
    WHERE empresa = $1 AND year = $2::int AND tipo = 'P'
      AND job NOT LIKE 'PP%' AND job NOT LIKE 'PY%'
    GROUP BY job
  ) t), '{}'::jsonb) AS v_se_facturacion_p_by_job,
  COALESCE((SELECT jsonb_object_agg(job, s) FROM (
    SELECT job, ROUND(SUM(coste)::numeric, 2) AS s
    FROM v_se_coste
    WHERE empresa = $1 AND year = $2::int AND tipo = 'R'
      AND job NOT LIKE 'PP%' AND job NOT LIKE 'PY%'
    GROUP BY job
  ) t), '{}'::jsonb) AS v_se_coste_r_by_job,
  COALESCE((SELECT jsonb_object_agg(job, s) FROM (
    SELECT job, ROUND(SUM(coste)::numeric, 2) AS s
    FROM v_se_coste
    WHERE empresa = $1 AND year = $2::int AND tipo = 'P'
      AND job NOT LIKE 'PP%' AND job NOT LIKE 'PY%'
    GROUP BY job
  ) t), '{}'::jsonb) AS v_se_coste_p_by_job,
  COALESCE((SELECT SUM(coste) FROM v_se_coste
    WHERE empresa = $1 AND year = $2::int AND tipo = 'R'), 0) AS v_se_coste_r,
  COALESCE((SELECT SUM(coste) FROM v_se_coste
    WHERE empresa = $1 AND year = $2::int AND tipo = 'P'), 0) AS v_se_coste_p,
  COALESCE((SELECT json_agg(k) FROM (
    SELECT DISTINCT job_no || '|' || line_no || '|' || year::text || '|' || month::text AS k
    FROM bc_job_planning_line
    WHERE company_name = $1 AND year = $2::int
      AND status IN ('Planning','Quote','Open','Completed','Lost')
      AND job_no NOT LIKE 'PP%' AND job_no NOT LIKE 'PY%'
      AND (
        COALESCE(budget_date_year, 0) = 0
        OR (budget_date_year = year AND month >= budget_date_month)
      )
  ) t), '[]'::json) AS planif_keys,
  COALESCE((SELECT json_agg(k) FROM (
    SELECT DISTINCT job_no || '|' || COALESCE(job_unit_no, '') || '|' || year::text || '|' || month::text AS k
    FROM bc_expediente_mes
    WHERE company_name = $1 AND year = $2::int
      AND job_no NOT LIKE 'PP%' AND job_no NOT LIKE 'PY%'
      AND COALESCE(month_closing_status, '') NOT IN ('Completed', 'Lost')
  ) t), '[]'::json) AS expediente_keys,
  COALESCE((SELECT jsonb_object_agg(ym, n) FROM (
    SELECT year::text || '-' || LPAD(month::text, 2, '0') AS ym,
           COUNT(*)::int AS n
    FROM bc_meses_cerrados
    WHERE company_name = $1 AND year = $2::int
      AND job_no NOT LIKE 'PP%' AND job_no NOT LIKE 'PY%'
    GROUP BY year, month
  ) m), '{}'::jsonb) AS cerrados_by_month,
  COALESCE((SELECT jsonb_object_agg(job_no, s) FROM (
    SELECT job_no, ROUND(SUM(ABS(invoice))::numeric, 2) AS s
    FROM bc_job_ledger_entry_month
    WHERE company_name = $1 AND year = $2::int
      AND concepto_analitico_descripcion = 'Ingresos'
      AND job_no NOT LIKE 'PP%' AND job_no NOT LIKE 'PY%'
    GROUP BY job_no
  ) t), '{}'::jsonb) AS r_by_job,
  COALESCE((SELECT jsonb_object_agg(job_no, s) FROM (
    SELECT job_no, ROUND(SUM(invoice)::numeric, 2) AS s
    FROM bc_job_planning_line
    WHERE company_name = $1 AND year = $2::int
      AND status IN ('Planning','Quote','Open','Completed','Lost')
      AND job_no NOT LIKE 'PP%' AND job_no NOT LIKE 'PY%'
      AND (
        COALESCE(budget_date_year, 0) = 0
        OR (budget_date_year = year AND month >= budget_date_month)
      )
    GROUP BY job_no
  ) t), '{}'::jsonb) AS p_planif_by_job,
  COALESCE((SELECT jsonb_object_agg(job_no, s) FROM (
    SELECT job_no, ROUND(SUM(invoice)::numeric, 2) AS s
    FROM bc_expediente_mes
    WHERE company_name = $1 AND year = $2::int
      AND job_no NOT LIKE 'PP%' AND job_no NOT LIKE 'PY%'
      AND COALESCE(month_closing_status, '') NOT IN ('Completed', 'Lost')
    GROUP BY job_no
  ) t), '{}'::jsonb) AS p_expediente_by_job,
  COALESCE((SELECT jsonb_object_agg(job_no, s) FROM (
    SELECT job_no, ROUND(SUM(cost)::numeric, 2) AS s
    FROM bc_job_planning_line
    WHERE company_name = $1 AND year = $2::int
      AND status IN ('Planning','Quote','Open','Completed','Lost')
      AND job_no NOT LIKE 'PP%' AND job_no NOT LIKE 'PY%'
      AND (
        COALESCE(budget_date_year, 0) = 0
        OR (budget_date_year = year AND month >= budget_date_month)
      )
    GROUP BY job_no
  ) t), '{}'::jsonb) AS p_cost_by_job,
  COALESCE((SELECT jsonb_object_agg(job_no, s) FROM (
    SELECT job_no, ROUND(SUM(cost)::numeric, 2) AS s
    FROM bc_job_ledger_entry_month
    WHERE company_name = $1 AND year = $2::int
      AND job_no NOT LIKE 'PP%' AND job_no NOT LIKE 'PY%'
    GROUP BY job_no
  ) t), '{}'::jsonb) AS r_cost_by_job,
  COALESCE((SELECT jsonb_object_agg(job_no, s) FROM (
    SELECT job_no, ROUND(SUM(invoice)::numeric, 2) AS s
    FROM bc_historico_planificacion_mes
    WHERE company_name = $1 AND year = $2::int
      AND job_no NOT LIKE 'PP%' AND job_no NOT LIKE 'PY%'
    GROUP BY job_no
  ) t), '{}'::jsonb) AS historico_by_job,
  COALESCE((SELECT SUM(invoice) FROM bc_historico_planificacion_mes
    WHERE company_name = $1 AND year = $2::int
      AND job_no NOT LIKE 'PP%' AND job_no NOT LIKE 'PY%'), 0) AS historico_sum,
  COALESCE((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bc_historico_planificacion_mes
    WHERE company_name = $1 AND year = $2::int
      AND job_no NOT LIKE 'PP%' AND job_no NOT LIKE 'PY%'), 0) AS historico_count,
  COALESCE((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bc_dias_imputacion WHERE company_name = $1), 0) AS dias_count,
  COALESCE((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bc_job WHERE company_name = $1), 0) AS job_count,
  COALESCE((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bc_resource WHERE company_name = $1), 0) AS resource_count,
  COALESCE((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bc_job_ledger_entry_line
    WHERE company_name = $1 AND year = $2::int), 0) AS line_count,
  COALESCE((SELECT SUM(ABS(total_price)) FROM bc_job_ledger_entry_line
    WHERE company_name = $1 AND year = $2::int
      AND concepto_analitico_descripcion = 'Ingresos'), 0) AS line_r_sum,
  COALESCE((SELECT json_agg(x) FROM (
    SELECT e.id, e.status, e.finished_at,
           COALESCE(e.details->'sync_details', '{}'::jsonb) AS sync_details
    FROM sync_executions e
    WHERE e.company_name = $1
      AND e.status IS DISTINCT FROM 'running'
      AND (
        COALESCE(e.details->>'workflow','') = '004'
        OR e.details ? 'sync_details'
      )
    ORDER BY e.id DESC
    LIMIT 1
  ) x), '[]'::json) AS last_004,
  COALESCE((
    SELECT ROUND(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (NOW() - MAX(started_at)))/3600.0, 2)
    FROM sync_executions
    WHERE company_name = $1
      AND status = 'ok'
      AND (
        COALESCE(details->>'workflow','') = '004'
        OR details ? 'sync_details'
      )
  ), 9999) AS hours_since_last_ok,
  COALESCE((
    SELECT COUNT(*)::int FROM sync_executions
    WHERE company_name = $1
      AND status = 'running'
      AND started_at < NOW() - INTERVAL '30 minutes'
  ), 0) AS mutex_stuck_count,
  COALESCE((
    SELECT ROUND(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (NOW() - MAX(started_at)))/60.0, 1)
    FROM sync_executions
    WHERE company_name = $1 AND status = 'running'
  ), 0) AS mutex_running_minutes,
  COALESCE((
    SELECT COUNT(*)::int FROM sync_executions
    WHERE company_name = $1
      AND status IN ('error', 'partial_error')
      AND started_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '24 hours'
      AND (
        COALESCE(details->>'workflow','') = '004'
        OR details ? 'sync_details'
      )
  ), 0) AS sync_exec_errors_24h,
  COALESCE((
    SELECT ROUND(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (NOW() - last_sync_at))/3600.0, 2)
    FROM sync_state
    WHERE company_name = $1 AND entity = 'bc_dias_imputacion'
  ), 9999) AS age_h_dias_imputacion,
  COALESCE((
    SELECT ROUND(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (NOW() - last_sync_at))/3600.0, 2)
    FROM sync_state
    WHERE company_name = $1 AND entity = 'bc_historico_planificacion_mes'
  ), 9999) AS age_h_historico_planif

INSERT INTO analytics_health_log
(company_name, year, check_name, bc_value, analytics_value, delta, status, details, alert_sent)
SELECT
  $1, $2::int, $3, NULLIF($4,'')::numeric, NULLIF($5,'')::numeric, NULLIF($6,'')::numeric,
  $7, COALESCE(NULLIF($8,'')::jsonb, '{}'::jsonb), ($9 = 'true')

SELECT company_name, check_name, bc_value, analytics_value, delta, status
FROM analytics_health_log
WHERE checked_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '15 minutes'
  AND status = 'fail'
ORDER BY company_name, check_name

SELECT
  COALESCE((
    SELECT ROUND(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (NOW() - MAX(started_at)))/3600.0, 2)
    FROM sync_executions
    WHERE company_name = $1
      AND status = 'ok'
      AND (
        COALESCE(details->>'workflow','') = '004'
        OR details ? 'sync_details'
      )
  ), 9999) AS hours_since_last_ok,
  COALESCE((
    SELECT COUNT(*)::int FROM sync_executions
    WHERE company_name = $1
      AND status = 'running'
      AND started_at < NOW() - INTERVAL '30 minutes'
  ), 0) AS mutex_stuck_count,
  COALESCE((
    SELECT ROUND(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (NOW() - MAX(started_at)))/60.0, 1)
    FROM sync_executions
    WHERE company_name = $1 AND status = 'running'
  ), 0) AS mutex_running_minutes,
  COALESCE((
    SELECT COUNT(*)::int FROM sync_executions
    WHERE company_name = $1
      AND status IN ('error', 'partial_error')
      AND started_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '24 hours'
      AND (
        COALESCE(details->>'workflow','') = '004'
        OR details ? 'sync_details'
      )
  ), 0) AS sync_exec_errors_24h,
  COALESCE((
    SELECT ROUND(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (NOW() - last_sync_at))/3600.0, 2)
    FROM sync_state
    WHERE company_name = $1 AND entity = 'bc_dias_imputacion'
  ), 9999) AS age_h_dias_imputacion,
  COALESCE((
    SELECT ROUND(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (NOW() - last_sync_at))/3600.0, 2)
    FROM sync_state
    WHERE company_name = $1 AND entity = 'bc_historico_planificacion_mes'
  ), 9999) AS age_h_historico_planif
